questions.question: Use tens and ones to add. What is 38 + 27?
questions.explain: 30 + 20 = 50 and 8 + 7 = 15, so 50 + 15 = 65. The 15 ones make one more ten, so do not stop at 55.

questions.question: Add 26 + 36 in parts: 20 + 30 = 50 and 6 + 6 = 12. What is the sum?
questions.explain: 50 + 12 = 62, because 12 is 1 ten and 2 ones. If you got 52, you forgot that extra ten.

questions.question: Break 45 into 40 + 5 and 23 into 20 + 3. What is 45 + 23?
questions.explain: 40 + 20 = 60 and 5 + 3 = 8, so 60 + 8 = 68. Be sure to add every part, both the tens and both the ones.

questions.question: You have 5 tens and 7 ones. You get 2 more tens and 6 more ones. What number do you have now?
questions.explain: 5 tens and 2 tens make 70. 7 ones and 6 ones make 13, and 70 + 13 = 83, not 73.

questions.question: Maya adds 29 + 45. She uses a friendly number and finds 30 + 45 = 75. What is 29 + 45?
questions.explain: 30 is 1 more than 29, so take 1 away from 75 to get 74. If you stop at 75, you forgot to fix the friendly number.

questions.question: Liam has 36 hockey cards. His aunt gives him 28 more. How many cards does Liam have now?
questions.explain: 30 + 20 = 50 and 6 + 8 = 14, so 50 + 14 = 64. The 14 ones give one more ten, so the answer is not 54.

questions.question: Which one gives the same sum as 48 + 25?
questions.explain: 48 is 2 less than 50, so add 50 + 25 = 75 and then take away 2 to get 73. If you use 50, you must fix it at the end.

questions.question: One ribbon is 37 cm long. Another ribbon is 45 cm long. How long are the two ribbons together?
questions.explain: 37 + 40 = 77, then 77 + 5 = 82, so the ribbons are 82 cm. Do not forget the 5 ones in 45.

questions.question: Noah adds 58 + 27. He changes 58 to the friendly number 60. What must he add to 60 to get the same sum?
questions.explain: Noah moved 2 from 27 over to 58 to make 60, so 27 becomes 25. If he keeps 27, the sum is 2 too big.

questions.question: Zoe has 27 red beads and 34 blue beads. Then she buys 20 more beads. How many beads does Zoe have now?
questions.explain: 27 + 34 = 61, because 7 + 4 = 11 gives one more ten. Then 61 + 20 = 81.

questions.question: Kai adds 46 + 27 and gets 63. What went wrong?
options: He added 50 + 27 and did not fix it.
He left out the 7 ones from the 27.
He forgot the extra ten from 6 + 7.
He wrote 6 tens beside the 13 ones.
questions.explain: 6 + 7 = 13, which is 1 ten and 3 ones, so 60 + 13 = 73. Kai kept the 3 but forgot the extra ten.

questions.question: Mia has $45. Grandma gives her $19. Then Mia earns $5 more. How much money does Mia have now?
